items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: I remember hearing I Dream of Jeannie

ctx.x: It’s funny you mention that, because a lot of the TV themes now, I’ll challenge somebody, whistle the theme from Law & Order. They’re sounds almost, some of them. It’s cool, but I know what you’re talking about. It’s not like “Peter Gunn.”
Oh yeah it’s not like — I remember hearing I Dream of Jeannie, or Mission Impossible, or even Star Trek. You know that theme’s kind of based on “Out of Nowhere.”
